summary.name: ChatGTT
summary.one_liner: ChatGTT (chatgtt.cc) is a browser-based tool that turns one selfie or pet photo into a ~10–13 second vertical AI meme video of the "card declined" checkout-roast trend.
keywords: i heard you the first time bro
use_cases: Make a card-declined meme video of yourself from one photo
Turn a pet photo into a viral checkout-roast short
Create 9:16 clips for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts
Generate a meme video without writing a prompt or editing
Make a quick joke video from a single selfie
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a generator where you upload one clear face or pet photo and it produces a ~10–13 second 9:16 vertical AI meme that recreates the "card declined" / "I heard you the first time, bro" checkout-roast skit. No prompt writing is needed. Output is an MP4 with original AI ambient audio and no watermark, and the page says render links expire so downloads should be saved promptly. Paid credit packs set the render count, with a 720p render costing 500 credits and a 480p render costing 375 credits. The page also lists a sample gallery of demo clips, including human and pet versions.
notable: One photo in, ~10–13s 9:16 meme video out, with no prompt writing
Original AI ambient audio only; no watermark on downloads
One-time credit packs with no subscription; from $8.88 (single), $16.99 (3-pack), $29.90 (creator)
Independent fan tool, explicitly not affiliated with OpenAI or ChatGPT
